source_evidence: Player exact 'Negotiate for the best payment. Perhaps there is something other than coin in addition? Maybe theres political capital to be gained? or a magic item(s)?' authorizes negotiation, not contract acceptance or unchosen V resource expenditure. Guild reserve maximum2500gp from fixed OR-CR-CA packet; no evidence organizer can allocate more coin or own a transferable magical item. Before RNG DC14 for appraisal/introduction services, DC18 for written endorsement on success, DC23 for offer250gp advance credited against first milestone (not extra reward). Mara meaningfully Helps frame reciprocal benefits; Cirren independently casts at-will Guidance before discussion, no slot and concentration ends after check. Genuine visible python_user_visible execution batch c9c636f5b2a476cb3ef6c8f961d80b6e, advantage d20 faces11,12 select12 +Persuasion6 +Luckstone1 +Guidance d4face3=22. DC14/18 succeeded, DC23 not met. Organizer offers original cash terms plus guild-sponsored professional appraisal and introductions to craft/merchant contacts including magic brokers, and on completion written endorsement of V/House Vaishnavi's demonstrated contribution and introductions to assembly representatives. No guarantee any item offered, vote or royal favor, no power to bind another House, no public accusation or pledge. No V superiority dice used. V retains choice whether to accept or invoke Commanding Presence on current check; no automatic contract, advance, magic item, reward, fee or expenditure. D314~19:25 Caereth guild courtyard. Defense quest negotiation successful with genuine V Persuasion advantage faces11,12 +6+Luckstone1 +Guidance3=22, thresholds14 and18 met,23 signing advance not met. Organizer can offer established capped 2500gp (833 safe civilians/functioning meeting,1667 ending coercive hold), no reduction or added cash; additional guild-funded professional appraisal of recovered specimens and introductions to reputable guild merchants/craftspeople including magical item brokers, plus written guild endorsement/testimonial recognizing V/House Vaishnavi's service on successful completion and introductions to assembly representatives through consenting guilds. No guaranteed magic item, office, vote, Crown recognition, political allegiance, sale discount, independent House pledge or actual earned benefit. 250gp advance credited against first milestone not offered at current result; optional Commanding Presence remains unspent if V expressly wishes to press the negotiation, no reroll. V has not accepted contract; may accept, press or defer. D315 meeting late afternoon, palace audience still pending, no original evidence transferred. Marriage recognized Crownsunder, Elara independently supportive of investigation without House commitment. V purse383gp4sp6cp food21/feed28, V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 full, no concentration, rest3/6. Mara/Elara/4 horses healthy. Specimen and sensitive evidence custody unchanged. No purchase/dinner/night yet; dice delegated until stop.
